newsitem.title: USA: NewReach says ends merger, changes name.
newsitem.headline: NewReach says ends merger, changes name.

text.p: NewReach Communications Inc, formerly Advent Technologies Inc, said it had dissolved its merger with the original NewReach Communications and was changing its name to Henley Group Inc.
The company said it had applied for a new stock symbol.
Advent, which used to trade on the bulletin board under the symbol AVTI, acquired NewReach in September 1996 and took on the name NewReach Communications Inc.

Now that the merger has been rescinded, and the two companies are separate. The original NewReach has transferred all its assets to a company called Granite Consulting Corp and will be known under that name.
Richard Dwyer, who served as president of the merged companies, has moved to Granite, and Martin Swarzman, who used to be president of Advent, will be president of Henley Group, a spokesman said.
